declaration.line: Hard sci-fi strategy on the real orbits of 2200

declaration.description: Belt 2200, a hard sci-fi strategy game in the browser: the solar system in the year 2200 on real orbits. Run the Free Belt's Hearth Station at Ceres, plan burns and coasts with their delta-v, propellant and time, and mine ice while the Mars Union and the Terran Compact fly their own routes.
